sources.title: Enterprise AI Model Switching: Why 92% of Fortune 500 Diversify
sources.snippet: Usage data shows no single AI model excels across all enterprise functions. Single-Model Market Share Collapsed in 2025 Perplexity's platform serves 92% of Fortune 500 companies including six of the Magnificent 7. In January 2025, two models captured 91.5% of enterprise queries: Claude Sonnet 4 held 47.5% share and GPT-4o held 44%.
